The City Mayor’s Office – Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering Unit (CMO-ABE) spearheaded the blessing and turnover of a wing van truck to the City Government of Cabanatuan. The vehicle was provided by the Department of Agriculture Regional Field Office III to further strengthen the City's agricultural and biosystems engineering support services.

The truck will primarily support the operations of the Cabanatuan City Rice Processing Center (CCRPC) by facilitating the transport and delivery of palay, milled rice, agricultural inputs, equipment, and other essential supplies. It will also be utilized in the implementation of various agricultural programs and operational activities of the City Government, contributing to more efficient service delivery and strengthened support for the local farming community.

For concerns regarding agricultural machineries and infrastructures, you may send us a message through this FB page or visit us at the ABE Unit Office, Cabanatuan City Hall.

Apektado na ng mga pag-ulan dulot ng binabantayang Low Pressure Area (LPA) ang ilang bahagi ng #EasternVisayas, #BicolRegion, at #Caraga dahil sa patuloy nitong paggalaw papalapit sa bansa.

Hindi inaalis ang posibilidad na ito ay maging bagyo habang nasa loob ng PAR (Philippine Area of Responsibility). Kapag naging ganap na bagyo, maaari itong pangalanang #HenryPH.

Inaasahang tatawid ang LPA o posibleng bagyo sa bahagi ng Eastern Visayas at Southern Luzon, na maaaring magdulot ng malawakang pag-ulan sa #MetroManila at iba pang bahagi ng #Luzon at #Visayas.

Posible rin nitong palakasin ang #Habagat, na magdadala ng karagdagang pag-ulan lalo na sa kanlurang bahagi ng Visayas, Mindanao, at Southern Luzon.

⚠️ Pinapaalalahanan ang lahat na maging alerto sa posibleng biglaang pagbaha, pagguho ng lupa, at iba pang epekto ng masamang panahon.

Manatiling nakatutok sa mga opisyal na ulat ng panahon.
